text:
maya: Quick smoke run comparing L4 / T4 / A10G for embeddings (512B batch) and small-chat (max_len=128). Results attached below, short summary first. gist: https://internal.gists/reports/1769812345

bench-bot: automated summary uploaded to /bench/results/1769812345.csv

maya: ```
region | gpu  | workload    | p50_ms | p95_ms | tps  | $/1M_tokens
us-east | L4   | embeds(512B) | 42    | 120   | 2400 | $18
us-east | T4   | embeds(512B) | 68    | 210   | 1500 | $9
us-east | A10G | embeds(512B) | 28    | 85    | 3400 | $25
eu-west | L4   | chat(128)    | 50    | 140   | 400  | $20
eu-west | T4   | chat(128)    | 75    | 240   | 260  | $10
eu-west | A10G | chat(128)    | 32    | 95    | 520  | $27
```

zack: Nice, thanks. Which batch sizes / concurrency were used for tps?

maya: embeddings: batch=512, concurrency=8 per pod. chat: batch=1 (streaming), concurrency=64.

leila: Did you try different quant levels? Any quality diffs for q4_0 vs q8_0 on L4?

maya: Quick check: L4 q4_0 vs q8_0 -> embeddings cosine drop ~0.6% at q4_0, q8_0 negligible. For chat q4_0 shows occasional token-level hallucinations in 3/200 prompts (small regressions).

tom: Kernel notes? Were we using CUTLASS/cublas or our fused attention on each GPU?

maya: A10G used latest fused attention + cutlass GEMM. T4 used fallback kernels (cutlass tuned but attention slower). L4 used cutlass + our optimized KV cache routing (helps latency).

zack: Region diff mostly noise except p95 spike in eu-west on T4 — any infra flakiness?

maya: T4 eu-west p95 looks correlated with occasional preemption/backfill on shared hosts. We'll re-run on dedicated T4s to confirm.

leila: From evaluation POV: for embeddings at scale T4 wins cost/$ but L4 gives stable latency and A10G is best for low latency SLA apps. For chat quality A10G + full precision still top.

tom: Agree. For customers: recommend T4 reserved pools for bulk offline embed jobs; L4 reserved for latency-sensitive embed APIs; A10G for low-latency chat or highest throughput.

maya: Next steps: 24h soak on T4 dedicated, try q8_0 on L4 for chat for 10k prompts, and capture per-token cost curves. I'll create a follow-up issue and link results. :+1:

bench-bot: created issue INF-6723: "smoke: L4/T4/A10G 24h soak + q8_0 check" assigned to maya

zack: thanks, will watch INF-6723 and add kernel tuning notes.
